build_animatediff_sparsectrl_pipeline: build a python module to create an AnimateDiffSparseControlNetPipeline for controlled text-to-video generation
run_sparsectrl_video_generation: run the AnimateDiffSparseControlNetPipeline to generate a video from text prompts and conditioning frames
create_sparsectrl_conditioning: create sparse control conditioning frames and masks for specific frame indices in the pipeline
encode_prompt_for_animatediff: encode text prompts into CLIP embeddings for use with the AnimateDiffSparseControlNetPipeline
decode_latents_to_video: decode video latents back to pixel space using the VAE decoder in the pipeline
